name: http-call
description: The subject method (or type, for code outside methods) sends an HTTP request: the HTTP method and URL, such as POST http://payments:8080/api/payments, or the URL alone when the method is not known. Placeholders are resolved against the config of the code's module; one nothing resolves is kept as written (${TAX_SERVICE_URL}), and an expression the extractor does not follow is shown as its source in braces ({productId}). User information, query and fragment are left out of every URL. A Feign client called by name goes to http://<name>, as Spring Cloud OpenFeign sends it. Values are those of the default view unless profile is set.

httpMethod.description: The HTTP method, such as GET. Absent when the code does not say which.

path.description: The URL's path, starting with /: everything after the scheme and authority, or after a leading placeholder or expression that stands for them. Absent when a placeholder or expression stands for the whole URL.

url.description: The whole URL, when it starts with a scheme.

baseUrl.description: The URL's scheme and authority, such as http://payments:8080, when it starts with a scheme.

service.description: The client name the request is sent to, matched against a service's spring.application.name: a Feign client's name.

client.description: What sends the request: a Spring Cloud OpenFeign or MicroProfile REST client interface, RestTemplate, RestClient, WebClient or the Jakarta (or javax) REST client API.

clientType.description: The binary name of the client interface, for a declarative client; it may differ from the method's own type when the method is inherited.

annotation.description: The binary name of the mapping annotation on a client interface's method, such as org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping.

expressions.description: The source of the parts of the URL the extractor did not follow, as they appear in braces in it.

profile.description: The profile active instead of the default one when the URL was resolved. Absent for the default view; present only where the URL or service differs from it.

written.description: The URL as written in the code, when it differs from the resolved one (it had placeholders).

unresolved.description: The keys of the placeholders no config value resolved.

masked.description: Present and true when a placeholder named a secret, so the URL is recorded as written, not resolved, without path, url, baseUrl or service.

name: http-client
description: The subject interface is a declarative HTTP client: feign for a Spring Cloud OpenFeign client (@FeignClient), microprofile-rest-client for a MicroProfile REST client (@RegisterRestClient). Its methods carry the http-call facts. The code that enables or injects it, not the library that declares it, makes its calls (ENABLES, INJECTS).

annotation.description: The binary name of the annotation written on the interface that makes it a client, which may carry @FeignClient as a meta-annotation.

name: ENABLES
description: The subject type turns on the object client interface, as @EnableFeignClients does for the clients it lists or that are in its packages, so the application the subject belongs to makes the client's calls.

annotation.description: The binary name of the annotation written on the subject, which may carry @EnableFeignClients as a meta-annotation.

name: INJECTS
description: The subject type has the object client interface injected, through a field or a constructor parameter of that type, so its code calls the client.

member.description: The entity ID of the field or constructor that takes the client.
